description: This file contains utility functions for processing content blocks, specifically extracting, normalizing, and highlighting internal links within content blocks in the Notesnook project.

methods.name: extractInternalLinks
methods.description: Extracts internal links from a content block using a specific regex pattern.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Adjusts link positions and replaces link text within a content block.

methods.name: highlightInternalLinks
methods.description: Highlights internal links in a content block that match a specific note ID.

methods.name: ellipsize
methods.description: Truncates text to a maximum length, adding ellipses at start or end as specified.
